findings.title: In-app updater is documented as the shipped primary distribution path but cannot reach any manifest
findings.details: CLAUDE.md:5 states 'shipping via in-app updater' and :256 describes channel resolution via updateChannel.ts. useAppUpdate.ts:42/:56 call bare check() and never import updateChannel, so tauri-plugin-updater substitutes {{target}}=updater_os()='windows' and requests release/channels/windows.json, which does not exist (HTTP 404, verified live). The second caller, GmadFirstRunGate.tsx:43 -> updateChannel.ts:38, reaches dev.json but then looks up platforms['dev'] while dev.json:10 keys platforms by windows-x86_64{,-msi,-nsis}; get_urls uses a caller target verbatim with no fallback, so it fails before the version comparison. manifest-from-tauri.mjs:9-15 copies Tauri's platform ids, so a generated manifest can never carry a channel-name key, and channel-manifest.mjs:57 promotes via spread, so the first real promotion will also break stable.json. A third, unwired implementation exists at src-tauri/src/update_channel.rs:20-26, consumed only by a debug_assert.
findings.action: Pick one contract (platform-id keys with a non-{{target}} URL, or channel-name keys everywhere) and route useAppUpdate through it; until then correct CLAUDE.md:5,256 and PROJECT_FEATURE_MAP.md:105, which assert a working feature.
findings.outcome_note: Documentation corrected 2026-08-12 to match the code. No code behaviour was changed; where the code is the defect (CRIT-1) the docs now describe the defect instead of claiming the feature works.

findings.title: promote-release's 'Prove no artifact identity changed' gate is vacuous
findings.details: promote-release.yml:44 compares c.artifacts vs s.artifacts, but channel manifests key on platforms (channel-manifest.mjs:12 requires it and never emits artifacts). findings.title: G-Sentry documented as a 500ms GSI poll, and its documented emit logic omits the confirmation gate
findings.details: CLAUDE.md:43 says 'polls GSI every 500ms'. GSI is push-based (setup.rs:23-24 writes buffer 0.1) and Sentry::update is called only from the 250ms CV loop. FEAT-G-SENTRY.md:31-38 prints a Track struct and asserts it is the real one, then :49 emits on the 5s timer alone - but sentry.rs adds hits (:78), confirmed (:80), CONFIRM_HITS=4 (:44), CONFIRM_WINDOW_MS=4000 (:49), STALE_UNCONFIRMED_MS=6000 (:59) and :146-148 skips any unconfirmed track. An unconfirmed track is never emitted, which is the phantom-hero guard.
findings.action: Correct the poll claim and document the confirmation gate - it is a real safety behaviour, not an implementation detail.
